title: Oracle Finance Cloud-Presales
description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.


**Your Role**
-------------


Capgemini is looking for an experienced **Oracle Finance Cloud Senior Consultant** to lead **solution design, implementation, and presales activities** for Oracle Fusion Financials engagements. The role involves collaborating with business stakeholders, architects, technical teams, and sales teams to deliver scalable and best\-in\-class Finance Cloud solutions.


* Lead requirement gathering workshops, fit\-gap analysis, and solution design.
* Configure and implement Oracle Fusion Financials modules including **GL, AP, AR, FA, CM, Tax, Expenses, and Projects**.
* Drive Finance processes across **R2R, P2P, O2C, and Asset Accounting**.
* Support data migration, testing (SIT/UAT), user training, and go\-live activities.
* Collaborate with integration and reporting teams for **OIC, REST APIs, OTBI, BI Publisher, and FRS**.
* Provide post\-production support and continuous process improvement recommendations.
**Your Profile**
----------------


* Strong experience in Oracle Fusion Financials implementations.
* Expertise in Finance business processes, accounting, compliance, and statutory reporting.
* Knowledge of SLA, financial reporting, data migration (FBDI/ADFDI), and integrations.
* Experience in stakeholder management, client engagement, and workshop facilitation.
* Oracle Fusion Financials Certification preferred.
* Exposure to global implementations and multi\-country rollouts.
* Understanding of Oracle Fusion Financials AI capabilities.
**What you'll love about working with us**
------------------------------------------


* We value flexibility and support a healthy work\-life balance through remote and hybrid work options.
* Competitive compensation and benefits.
* Career development programs and certifications in cloud technologies.
* A diverse and inclusive workplace that fosters innovation and collaboration.
Capgemini is an AI\-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end\-to\-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22\.5 billion.


Capgemini in India comprises nearly 235,000 team members working across 13 locations: Bangalore, Bhubaneswar, Chennai, Coimbatore, Gandhinagar, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Noida, Pune, Salem, and Tiruchirappalli.

title: Fusion Finance Functional- PA/PPM (Project Accounting / Project Portfolio Management)
description:

**Your Role**
-------------


We are looking for an experienced **Oracle Fusion Finance Functional Consultant \- PA/PPM** to join our growing Oracle practice. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in implementing, configuring, and supporting Oracle Fusion Project Accounting (PA) and Project Portfolio Management (PPM) modules, along with a comprehensive understanding of Oracle Fusion Financials.


* Lead and participate in Oracle Fusion PPM/Project Accounting implementation and support projects.
* Gather, analyze, and document business requirements and translate them into functional solutions.
* Configure Oracle Fusion Project Financial Management modules including: Project Costing, Project Billing, Project Contracts, Project Control, Project Foundation, Project Resource Management
* Design solution architecture and perform application configurations based on business requirements.
* Conduct CRP, UAT, SIT, and end\-user training sessions.
* Work closely with technical teams for reports, integrations, conversions, and extensions.
**Your Profile**
----------------


* Support integrations between PPM and other Oracle Fusion modules such as GL, AP, AR, Procurement, and HCM.
* Prepare functional specifications and coordinate with development teams for customizations.
* Analyze production issues and provide effective resolutions within SLA timelines.
* Participate in data migration, cutover planning, and post\-go\-live support.
* Strong hands\-on experience in **Oracle Fusion Project Accounting (PA)** and **Project Portfolio Management (PPM)**.
* Expertise in: Project Costing, Project Billing, Project Contracts, Project Foundation, Project Performance Reporting
* Strong understanding of project lifecycle, revenue recognition, budgeting, forecasting, and cost management.
* Experience in requirement gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, and deployment.
